parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: Omit for legacy identity-only schema 1; 2 adds contact snapshot metadata, 3 adds deletion history, and 4 adds safe current vendor/rider onboarding metadata across countries.

get.description: Default schema 1 preserves the legacy identity-only export. Schema 2 adds safe contact snapshot metadata; schema 3 adds own deletion request history; schema 4 adds current vendor and rider onboarding metadata from owner-scoped database functions. Schema 4 excludes bank, phone, private evidence, review, and submission history. All schemas include profile, roles, own sessions and consent history across countries. No provider credentials, raw device identifiers, access/refresh tokens, phone HMACs, key IDs or credential digests. Current session is checked again before returning; no-store. Oversized synchronous snapshots fail without truncation. Other owner services remain outside coverage.

guestExchangeSignature.name: X-P4U-Guest-Signature
guestExchangeSignature.description: v1 HMAC-SHA256 over version, timestamp and exact request body

email.description: Optional profile contact email. Omission preserves the current value; an empty string clears it.

phone.description: Optional E.164 profile contact number. Omission preserves the current value; an empty string clears it.

expected_version.description: Required when granted is true. Last observed version for this purpose in the authenticated country, or 0 for no decision. Withdrawals ignore this precondition.

contact_snapshots.description: Present for schemas 2, 3 and 4. Safe metadata only; no phone numbers, hashes, key IDs or request fingerprints.

deletion_history.description: Present for schemas 3 and 4. Only the authenticated owner's identity-service deletion requests.

occupation_references.description: Schemas 3 and 4: own country-scoped occupation selections, including cleared selections.

vendor_applications.description: Schema 4 only: current subject-owned vendor onboarding metadata across countries.

rider_profiles.description: Schema 4 only: current subject-owned rider onboarding metadata across countries.

country.description: Null for preserved historical evidence whose country was not recorded.

occupation_id.description: Active occupation UUID; empty clears the selection.

x-planext4u-deprecation-policy: additive-v1; breaking changes require a new major contract
